what_to_detect: A blocking or attacking creature that would be destroyed in combat damage regenerates: a regenerated event, tapped, damage removed, removed from combat (removed_from_combat event).
near_miss: A creature dealt lethal combat damage with no regeneration shield is destroyed (destroyed/zone_change to graveyard).
record_fields: combat payload events: regenerated, removed_from_combat, tapped, destroyed

what_to_detect: A destroy effect that says the permanent can't be regenerated resolves against a permanent the snapshot before the resolution shows holding a regeneration shield (a floating effect from a Regenerate line affecting it), and the permanent is destroyed anyway (destroyed event, zone_change to the graveyard).
near_miss: A destroy effect resolves against a permanent holding a regeneration shield and the shield applies: a regenerated event, the permanent stays on the battlefield.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot floating_effects (source_lines, affected, shield_left) before the resolution
no rewrite record: Forge's ReplacementHandler drops a shield whose canReplace fails (Regeneration false) before executeReplacement, so the rewrite channel writes nothing for this case
